tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search real estate listings for sale or rent in Bulgaria (apartments, houses, offices, land) by city, neighborhood, price range, rooms, area. Use this whenever a user asks to find a home, apartment, house or property in Bulgaria. / Търси обяви за имоти за продажба и наем в България по град, квартал,

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get full details of one real estate listing by id, including description, all photos, features and agency contact. / Пълни данни за една обява по id.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send an inquiry about one listing to its agency on behalf of the user (name, email, optional phone and message). Use after the user picks a property and confirms they want to contact the agency. / Изпраща запитване до агенцията по конкретна обява от името на потребителя.

tools.name: subscribe_to_search
tools.description: Subscribe the user to a saved search: whenever a NEW listing matching these criteria appears, they get an email (and a phone push if they install the app). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: subscribe_to_search · Private data: get_property, send_inquiry · Public sink: send_inquiry, subscribe_to_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: subscribe_to_search · Private data: get_property, send_inquiry · Public sink: send_inquiry, subscribe_to_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
